questions.question:
A DataFrame currently uses employee_id as its index and contains columns name and score.
The analyst runs:
df = df.reset_index()
df = df.set_index("name")
What is the final role of employee_id?

options.text: It remains the index together with name
It is deleted from the DataFrame
It becomes the default integer index

aiExplanation.ar: لأن الاختيار «It becomes a normal column» هو التعريف أو السلوك الصحيح المرتبط بموضوع Pandas Inspection & Structure وفقًا لصياغة السؤال والإجابة الرسمية.
aiExplanation.label: AI Explanation — Arabic
